periods.summary: Kiriko appears drunken at Ikki's party, preventing Shizuku from properly asking to become her student there. In Hiroshima, she is shown as a beloved doctor who uses water-based healing to let terminal patients live actively until the end of their lives. She agrees to teach Shizuku without demanding payment because medicine gains value by being shared, but first insists on treating the hidden distortions Shizuku caused by her self-vaporization technique. Kiriko accepts Shizuku's request to remain conscious during the procedure only after warning her of the severe pain and restraints her for safety.

key_events.summary: Her drunken behavior delays Shizuku's request.
Diagnoses Shizuku and begins a painful corrective treatment.
